hypothesis.statement: Two independent clusters remain and only the second is unexplored. ENTRY CLUSTER (denied above, mechanism understood): our stream materialises lbl_8023DFD0's ADDR16_HA at 0x4 and gPlayers' at 0x14, while the target does the reverse and additionally completes gPlayers' ADDR16_LO pre-prologue at 0x10; probe 3 showed the ORDER is reachable by declaration order but that reaching it in-place costs two words elsewhere, and the sibling finding on print_n_of_m this same run (attempt.CL_print-n-of-m-in-place-multiply-frees-r0-for-the-pre-prologue-address.20260903.v1) names the missing half - the pre-prologue hoist happens only when the LO's destination is a register that is free BEFORE the parameter homes, which on that function was bought by forcing an unrelated product to coalesce with its own source, landing the constant at print_n_of_m's `@0x10 addi r0,r8,0 @lbl_8011D568(ADDR16_LO)` (that is print_n_of_m's definition site, quoted because the sibling record's id slug names the register; DoGoodWizard's own free-register question is untouched and no register is asserted for it here). The untried lever here is the same one: find the operation in DoGoodWizard's first block whose destination register the allocator is holding, and give it a coalescing form, so the address constant is pushed onto a register that is free pre-prologue. SECOND CLUSTER, never probed at all: at 0x1f4-0x218 ours emits `lwz`/`addi`/`stfs`/`lfs`/`lwz` where the target emits `addi`/`stfs`/`lwz`/`stfs`/`lfs`/`lwz`, a five-instruction window around the `node = *pp;` re-reads and the `pos[]` stores in case 3 (source lines 312-317). Our source re-reads `node = *pp;` before each of the three mat[3][N] stores; the aligned view shows the target interleaving one fewer reload at the head of that run, so the first thing to measure there is whether the target re-reads `*pp` before the FIRST store at all.
